WITH manager_awards_with_throws AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing') as throws
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
),
throw_counts AS (
  SELECT throws, COUNT(*) as tally
  FROM manager_awards_with_throws
  GROUP BY throws
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    tally,
    tally::NUMERIC / SUM(tally) OVER () as share
  FROM throw_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
),
above_avg_hands AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.throws,
    ws.tally,
    ws.share,
    asc.avg_share
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
  WHERE ws.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(tally) as combined_tally,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as above_average_amount
FROM above_avg_hands
